claims.claim: Cyril of Alexandria was Patriarch of Alexandria from 412 to 444.
Cyril of Alexandria was born circa 376 and died in 444.
Cyril of Alexandria succeeded his uncle Theophilus as bishop of Alexandria.
Cyril of Alexandria is chiefly known for his campaign against Nestorius, bishop of Constantinople, whose views on Christ's nature were declared heretical.
Cyril of Alexandria's exegetical writings make up seven out of his ten volumes in Migne's Patrologia series.
The Fragmenta in Danielem survives in Migne's Patrologia Graeca.
Cyril of Alexandria was named a doctor of the church in 1882.
